detectors.name: runtime_exec
flaws: Fails to capture the caller context (who is executing the command?).
Flags benign debugging strings if present in the APK.

detectors.name: dynamic_loading
flaws: Prone to false positives if the library merely exists but is never instantiated.
Does not provide the caller context (is the main app loading the dex, or a 3rd party ad SDK?).
